messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look list of the long weekends that Canadians will enjoy in 2023.  
(Only federal holidays that create a three‑day stretch are shown; provincial holidays that add extra days are noted where they matter.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if moved) | Long‑weekend span |
|---------|-------------|---------------------|-------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | Observed Mon Jan 2 | Dec 30–Jan 2 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario – except Toronto) | Monday Feb 20 | — | Feb 18–20 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | — | Apr 7–8 (Fri–Sat) |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | — | May 20–22 (Sat–Mon) |
| **St. Patrick’s Day** (NL) | Friday Mar 17 | — | Mar 17–18 (Fri–Sat) |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Observed Mon Jul 3 | Jul 1–3 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | — | Sep 2–4 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | — | Oct 7–9 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Remembrance Day** | Thursday Nov 11 | — | (No long weekend unless observed on Friday in some provinces) |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday Dec 25 | — | Dec 23–25 (Sat–Mon) |

### Provincial / Territorial extras that create long weekends

| Province/Territory | Holiday | Date | Long‑weekend span |
|--------------------|---------|------|-------------------|
| Ontario | Heritage Day | Friday Oct 16 | Oct 14–16 (Sat–Fri) |
| Yukon, Northwest Territories, Nunavut | National Indigenous Peoples Day | Friday Jun 21 | Jun 19–21 (Sat–Fri) |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | St. Patricks’ Day | Friday Mar 17 | Mar 17–18 (Fri–Sat) |
| Prince Edward Island | St. George’s Day | Wednesday Apr 23 | (Not a long weekend) |

> **Quick tip:** If you’re building a holiday‑planning app, you can use the above table to flag the “long‑weekend” periods automatically. Just remember that some holidays (like Remembrance Day) may be observed on a different day in certain provinces, so double‑check your target audience’s region.
